name: R018-endure-fixed-damage
why: Challenge 2 (the AI runs only AI_CheckBadMove). The opponent leads with Chansey 332 (Seismic Toss, Shadow Ball, Double Team, Soft-Boiled). Against the player's Normal-type Vigoroth 326 Shadow Ball is scored -10 and Soft-Boiled is bad at full HP, so Chansey picks Seismic Toss or Double Team. Vigoroth uses Endure every turn; Seismic Toss takes 50 HP at a time until Vigoroth has 50 HP or less. On the first Seismic Toss after that on a turn Endure worked, Cmd_adjustsetdamage clamps the damage to leave 1 HP and sets MOVE_RESULT_FOE_ENDURED. A failed Endure that turn (repeated Endure halves its chance) knocks Vigoroth out instead.
